pages.text: Recreate the reactor's failures on a small captured black hole to make $(thing)Recordings$(): crafting components you can't get any other way.$(br2)The $(l:safety/venting_lance)Venting Lance$() and the $(l:building/axial_stabilizers)axial stabilizers$() are made from them.

pages.title: Capturing a black hole
pages.text: Four $(item)Singularity Glass$() (from a collapse crater) make a $(item)Singularity Container$().$(br2)Throw it into a running reactor's black hole: it's flung back out as a $(item)Containment Box$() holding a tiny black hole.

pages.name: Research Chamber
pages.text: A 3x3x3 of $(item)Research Casing$(), the Containment Box in the middle and the $(item)Research Core$() in the middle of the front, facing out.

pages.title: Experiments
pages.text: Use the Research Core and pick a failure. The panel shows a random procedure: do each step in order, with $(thing)30 seconds$() per step.$(br2)Some steps are on the panel: set the $(thing)field$() and press Lock, $(thing)Pulse$() while the resonance lamp is green, $(thing)Vent$(), $(thing)Charge$().

pages.title: Steps in the world
pages.text: Others happen around the chamber:$(li)$(thing)Feed$(): use the asked-for item on the Research Core$(li)$(thing)Redstone$(): power the Research Core, or cut the signal$(li)$(thing)Tune$(): use the $(l:building/configurator)Configurator$() on the Containment Box$(br2)Finish the last step and the Recording pops out of the core.

pages.title: Getting it wrong
pages.text: Pressing the wrong control, using the Configurator at the wrong time, running out of time or breaking the chamber $(danger)loses the black hole$(): the containment gives way with a small blast (no block damage) and the box is gone. Capture another to try again.$(br2)$(thing)Abort$() stops safely.

pages.title: What the Recordings make
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Lance Emitter$() x27: Pre-meltdown, Breach and Meltdown Recordings + 3 obsidian$(li)$(item)Axial Emitter$(): Disc Stall, Overspin and Mass Starvation Recordings + a Stabilizer Emitter
